description: This Java class provides a supplier for generating the URI to be used in HTTP Location headers for responses indicating resource creation. It constructs the URI based on the incoming request, considering whether the request is idempotent and removing entity identifiers as needed.

classes.name: UriForLocationHeaderSupplier
classes.description: A final class implementing Supplier<Uri> that generates the URI for the Location header based on the HTTP request and command response, handling idempotency and entity ID removal.

methods.name: UriForLocationHeaderSupplier
methods.description: Constructor initializing the supplier with the HTTP request and command response objects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the Uri object representing the location header, constructed considering idempotency and entity IDs.

methods.name: isRequestIdempotent
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP method of the request is idempotent.

methods.name: removeEntityId
methods.description: Removes the entity ID segment from the request URI string, if present.

methods.name: getIndexOfEntityId
methods.description: Finds the index of the entity ID within the request URI string.

methods.name: removeTrailingSlash
methods.description: Removes a trailing slash from a URI string if present.

methods.name: getLocationUriString
methods.description: Constructs the location URI string by appending entity ID and resource path to the request URI.
